objectClass.primaryType: humanoid character - adult male Hindu devotee warrior, bare-chested in a wrapped saffron dhoti
objectClass.notes: Classified from the 360 turnaround, not from the character's name. Body is organic and articulated; the dhoti is a separate fabric-like layered shell over the pelvis and thighs; rudraksha beads are a repeated hard module. Motion requirement is articulation only - the figure runs, jumps and slides, it is never destructed or detached.

reasoning: silhouette 2: a clean readable humanoid outline, interrupted only by the hair bun and the dhoti drape.
componentCount 2: seven macro parts resolving to ~18 meso sub-parts; not a mechanical assembly.
hierarchyDepth 3: the rig needs root->hip->thigh->shin->foot and torso->arm->forearm->hand, four levels deep.
repetitionDensity 2: two bead-ring systems (necklace, four limb bands) plus the dhoti's fold ridges.
materialLayerCount 2: skin, hair, dhoti cloth, sash cord, bead, foot - six distinct surfaces.
localDetailDensity 2: identity rides on small marks (tilak, bead wrap on the bun, hem border).
occlusionRisk 1: unusually low - front, back AND side are all supplied. Only the hip joint under cloth, the sole and the bun underside are unobserved.
actionReadinessNeed 3: the whole point is a run/jump/slide rig, so every limb pivot is load-bearing.

specDepthDecision.rationale: complex, not moderate: the model is worthless without a four-level articulated hierarchy, and identity rests on repeated bead systems plus small marks that must be enumerated rather than described in prose. Not ultra-complex: there is no dense microstructure - the finish is flat cel colour with no wear, pattern or grain to reproduce.

unknownsToResolveBeforeImplementation: Dhoti hem length is inconsistent between the turnaround (just above the ankle) and the hero run (rides higher on the lifted leg). Modelled at the turnaround length; the run pose is procedural so the hem cannot follow the leg.
Hip joint centre is occluded by cloth in every view; its height is inferred from where the leg columns diverge.
Sole of the foot and the underside of the bun are not observed in any panel.
The anatomy panel's printed labels are garbled ('Flioiny', '=3"', '2.5 cm') and are unusable as numeric corroboration for the measured 6.45 HU.

Style tier is NOT confirmed by the user: the reference measures 6.45 HU, the character currently in the game is 3.6 HU, and an earlier re-proportioning was reverted. This model is authored standalone; adopting it in-game is a separate decision.

detailInventory.note: Enumerate every identity-defining small detail before authoring the spec. Each detail must map to a component.localFeatures entry or material.localOverrides entry, never prose only. Use forge/stage1_intake/build_detail_inventory.py to scan zones.

details.description: Spherical hair bun seated above and behind the crown; the tallest point of the silhouette.
A ring of rudraksha beads wound around the base of the bun, called out explicitly as 'Rudraksha detail'.
Bead loop sitting on the collarbones at the base of the throat.
Bead band around the LEFT upper arm at mid-shaft; the panel's 'Rudraksha' callout points at it.
Bead band around the RIGHT upper arm, mirroring the left.
Bead band on the left distal forearm.
Bead band on the right distal forearm.
Single cream cord from one shoulder to the opposite hip, crossing BOTH the chest and the back. Labelled 'Single sash'.
Short vertical red mark between the brows.
A single wound sash closing the dhoti at the waist, sitting proud of the wrap.
Vertical pleat panel hanging down the front centre of the wrap.
The wrap splits into two draped columns that sheathe the thighs and calves and end just above the ankle - a kachcha dhoti, NOT a short skirt.
Fine gold embroidered border along the hem. Below geometry scale - carried as a material band, not modelled.
Recessed groove down the centre of the back separating the erector masses.
Latissimus masses sweeping from the armpits to a waist ~0.62 of the shoulder span - the V that defines the back read.
No footwear; toes visible, ankle bare below the dhoti hem.
Ears standing proud of the skull, visible because the hair is pulled back into the bun.

pose.restPoseNote: The rig is authored in the A-pose the turnaround defines. The run/jump/slide poses are driven procedurally at runtime, not baked.
pose.jointAngleEvidence: Arm abduction read off the front turnaround: upper arms hang ~38 deg from vertical, forearms near-straight. Legs are close to vertical with a slight outward splay. Wrists/ankles are not clearly readable at this scale, so they stay at rest rather than being invented.

anatomy.note: Measured off 1:1 zone crops, not the whole-sheet overlay (whose head-unit ticks span the multi-panel sheet and do not align with the figure). 6.45 HU is measured, not snapped to a preset band. Full measurement basis and evidence refs in .img2threejs/anatomy.json.

definitionOfDone: Standing silhouette matches the turnaround at 6.45 head-units with the hip at half standing height, shoulders ~1.56 HU across and the waist ~0.62 of the shoulder span.
The dhoti reads as a full-length wrapped kachcha reaching the ankle in two draped columns, with a waist sash and a front pleat - not as a short skirt and not as a box.
All five rudraksha placements are present: throat, both upper arms, both wrists, plus the wrap at the bun base.
The janeu crosses shoulder-to-opposite-hip and is visible from BOTH front and back, since the game camera sees the back.
Every named pivot (legL, legR, shinL, shinR, armL, armR, torso, head) rotates about a real joint position, not a mesh centre.
Skin, hair, cloth, cord and bead each read as distinct surfaces under the game's moonlit rig without any baked highlight in their albedo.

featureGroups.name: Measured proportion lock
qualityCriteria: Hip joint sits at 0.50 +/- 0.03 of standing height.
Shoulder span 1.56 +/- 0.15 HU; waist 0.60-0.66 of the shoulder span.
failureModes: head scaled to a doll-like fraction of body height (the defect in the current in-game build at 3.6 HU)
legs shorter than half the standing height, which reads as stocky rather than athletic

featureGroups.name: Back silhouette and surface
qualityCriteria: Lat masses taper from armpit to waist producing a visible V.
A spine channel separates the two erector masses.
The janeu is visible crossing the bare back.
failureModes: flat slab back - the game camera looks straight at it, so this is the single most visible surface
janeu sunk inside the torso volume and invisible

featureGroups.name: Dhoti as a wrapped garment
qualityCriteria: Two draped leg columns reaching just above the ankle.
A waist sash sits proud of the wrap.
A front pleat panel hangs down the centre.
Fold ridges break the surface; no flat untextured panel.
failureModes: a box or a short skirt instead of a full-length wrap
hem cutting at mid-thigh, exposing the whole leg

featureGroups.name: Rudraksha repetition system
qualityCriteria: Bead rings at throat, both upper arms, both wrists and the bun base.
Individual beads read as discrete furrowed seeds, not a smooth torus.
failureModes: a smooth ring standing in for a bead string
armbands omitted - they are explicitly labelled in the reference

featureGroups.name: Animation-ready pivots
qualityCriteria: legL/legR pivot at the hip, shinL/shinR at the knee, armL/armR at the shoulder, torso at the waist, head at the neck.
Limb geometry is offset so rotation swings the limb, never spins it about its middle.
failureModes: a pivot placed at a mesh centroid, which makes a run look like clockwork
a limb that cannot reach the run/jump/slide poses without interpenetration

visualDeltaChecks: local feature placement and scale delta
antiShallowSpecRules: Do not proceed to code if qualityContract.qualityBar is unassessed.
Do not proceed to code if the spec only contains a root component for a moderate or complex object.
Do not proceed to code if required featureGroups are not represented by componentTree, materials, or repetitionSystems.
Do not proceed to code if visible local features are described only in prose and not attached to components/materials/evidenceRefs.
Do not proceed past structural-pass if attached child parts lack attachment.parentSocket, localStart, localEnd, embedDepth/overlap, and gapTolerance.
Do not pass material look-dev when albedo is reused as roughness, height, normal, or AO.
Do not pass material look-dev without macro, meso, and micro surface frequency bands for close-up materials.
Do not pass reference-fidelity material look-dev from a source image without usable referencePbr maps or an explicit documented limitation.
Do not patch a spec with extracted PBR maps when extraction confidence is below the target threshold unless the user explicitly accepts lower fidelity.
Do not place adjacent separate-geometry parts below 0.02 world-unit seam overlap (source: grimoire/build/geometry_patterns.md).
Do not satisfy raised or recessed relief, fasteners, or grip structure with a map alone when the feature affects form; use geometry or displacement (source: grimoire/build/geometry_patterns.md).
blockingFailureModes: any proportion outside the proportion-lock tolerances
dhoti modelled as a box or ending above the knee
any named pivot rotating about a mesh centre
